Data Engineer salary in the United States

Based on 245 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 24, 2026), listed pay for Data Engineer jobs in the United States is $118,560–$163,800 a year (middle 50% of listed salary midpoints). The median listed midpoint is about $140,000 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $140,000 a year across 245 current postings. The middle 50% is $118,560–$163,800 a year.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Capital One: about $201,625 a year (median of 4 listings); Clera: about $190,000 a year (median of 2 listings); Stellar Professionals: about $174,200 a year (median of 2 listings); Tono Health: about $165,000 a year (median of 2 listings); Travelers: about $160,050 a year (median of 2 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

What pay is listed for entry-level and new-grad jobs?

The median listed midpoint is about $109,000 a year from 15 entry-level and new-grad postings with usable pay. Internship listings are excluded from this comparison.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
